tools.name: Daiwik Hindi/English Typing Tutor
tools.description: Bilingual government exam typing tutor. Supports Mangal (Inscript, Remington CBI, Remington GAIL) & Krutidev-010 plus English typing with real-time WPM, backspace penalty and accuracy calculation.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Run setup.
2. Open Daiwik_Keygen.exe to generate custom hardware keys.
3. Or use default Master Key: DAIWIK-PRO-2026-UNLIMITED-LIFETIME

tools.name: Ankit Automated (Gmail Bill & RDP Engine)
tools.description: Commercial email invoice extractor, QuickBooks automation and RDP sync engine. Includes official KeyGenerator.exe for client machine activation.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Run ankitautomated.exe.
2. Open KeyGenerator.exe and paste client Machine ID to generate activation key.
3. Universal Master Key (Admin only): ANKIT-MASTER-VIP-2026

tools.name: Mocx Pro Exam Platform (PC)
tools.description: Enterprise-grade computer based examination engine for coaching institutes & schools. Anti-cheat screen lock, automatic timer, instant answer key grading.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Run MocxPro_Setup.exe to install.
2. Open software and paste Master Key.
3. Complete payload zip contains raw question banks and student portal.

tools.name: Super PC Optimizer & RAM Booster
tools.description: Grand Master v16 maintenance utility. Deep registry cleanup, Windows temp purging, RAM defrag. Includes SPO_Admin_KeyGenerator for customer licensing.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Run setup.
2. Open SPO_Admin_KeyGenerator.exe, paste customer Machine ID to create 1-Year or Lifetime Key.
3. Master Key: SUPER-PC-CLEANER-PRO

tools.name: Pharma POS Enterprise Keygen Suite
tools.description: Dedicated cryptographic key generator for Pharma POS billing software. Generates hardware-locked retail terminal licenses.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Open PharmaPOS_Keygen.exe.
2. Select hardware node and click Generate.
3. Master Key: PHARMA-ENTERPRISE-FOUNDER-ACTIVATED

tools.name: AnkitGravity AI IDE Desktop
tools.description: Executive AI Development Studio with integrated Antigravity engine, multi-agent terminal orchestrator, live git synchronization, and scratch workspace builder.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Run setup.
2. Select workspace directory.
3. Automatic Antigravity CLI and model binding initialized.

tools.name: Antigravity Quota Monitor Pro
tools.description: Windows system tray floating monitor tracking live AI quota, rate limits, token consumption, and background task diagnostics across active agent sessions.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Double click to run.
2. Minimizes to system tray near clock.
3. Right click for live quota stats.

tools.name: Apex ERP Enterprise Retail
tools.description: Ultra fast portable desktop retail ERP. POS thermal invoice printing, GST billing, inventory stock warnings, barcode scanning, and daily cash drawer reconciliation.
tools.installationGuide:
1. Run setup.
2. Configure company details and GSTIN.
3. Ready for offline billing.

tools.installationGuide:
